entries.en: Halfsix seems to be giggling to himself.

entries.ja: イディルシャイアのハーフシクスは、いたずらを企んでいる。

entries.en: Halfsix has seemingly crafted devices able to interrupt Illuminati communications. Now, he wishes you to plant these contraptions around the Makers' Quarter, so as to vex the mortal enemies of Idyllshire. Make your way to the Dravanian hinterlands, and set up the three jamming devices now.
entries.fr: Halfsix souhaite gêner les Gobelins de la Main indigo avec ses “<frnoun(EventItem,12,2001712,2,1)>” faits maison. Placez les trois appareils aux <frnoun(EObj,12,2005874,2,1)> qu'il vous a indiqués.
entries.ja: ハーフシクスから、「青の手」がうろつく場所に、<sheet(EventItem,2001712,0)>の設置を頼まれた。低地ドラヴァニアのシャーレアン工匠街で、「<sheet(EObj,2005874,0)>」に、「<sheet(EventItem,2001712,0)>」を3個設置しよう。

entries.en: You plant all three jamming devices in a crescent pattern around the Arkhitekton. Report back to Halfsix, and tell him the great “joke” you two have played on Illuminati.
entries.fr: Vous avez mis en place les <frnoun(EventItem,12,2001712,2,1)>. Retournez voir Halfsix.

entries.en: Upon hearing that the deed is done, Halfsix must stifle his own laughter when imagining exactly how frustrating it will be for the Illuminati to lose their ability to communicate. Though he does not thank you in so many words, you sense you have won the goblin's trust.
entries.fr: Halfsix est ravi à l'idée que des Gobelins de la Main indigo vont sans doute se faire piéger par ses appareils.
entries.ja: ハーフシクスに報告した。設置した<sheet(EventItem,2001712,0)>で、「青の手」の通信を妨害するいたずらを仕掛け、ハーフシクスはほくそ笑むのだった。
